title: Fourier weight on the selected family
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$ with positive variance. Let $\mathcal F$ consist of all nonempty coordinate sets contained in the variance-based Friedgut coordinate set whose size is at most the variance-based Friedgut degree. Then $3\operatorname{Var}(f)/4$ is at most the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over $S\in\mathcal F$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
caveat: The selected family is defined through several upstream quantities whose informal definitions are absent from the supplied definitions list; the statement gives its construction in terms of the named variance-based Friedgut quantities.
